page.layout: One text column on the right printed page, with the running head and page number at the top; a narrow fragment of the left page (its outer margin notes and text) at the left edge. Below the text, a short signature-like word "Sic" at the right. Notes in the left-page margin are fragments of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Primus initio 250 aureos attulit, tri-
mestri autem exacto 100 iterum sub-
duxit. Alter post bimestre 180 au-
reos cōtulit, elapso uero societatis se-
mestri 50 repetijt. Tertius post tres
menses 235 contulit: itemq; post quin-
tum superaddidit 45. Lucro autem 68
aureorum existente, quæ cuiusque
portio?
Eiusmodi exempla specie impeditissima, laboris p-
lus requirūt, alioquin eadem arte pertractanda. Ex-
pedientur autem si eam industriam adhibeas, ut ob for-
tium mutationem cuiusuis tempus competens secernas,
totq; multiplicationes instituas, quot mutationes contin-
gere. Vt in exemplo præsenti, quoniam primus 250 au-
reos tribus mensibus in consortio reliquit, multiplicentur
inuicem, factus erit 750, reliquis igitur nouē mensibus,
subtractis centum aureis, 150 tantum in consortio re-
mansêre. Quare hi iterum in suum tempus multiplicati,
faciunt 1350. Quibus inter se additis, totus pro primo
socio est 2100.
Ita secundi 180 aurei per quatuor menses, quibus eos
in communi negociatione reliquit, multiplicati, faciunt
720. Porrò subductis 50 aureis à 180 (tot enim à prin-
cipali summa sexto consortij mense repetijt) restant 130
aurei, quos si in residuos sex menses multiplices, factus e-
rit 780, qui priori additus, constituit 1500.
Sic

page.notes: The left-page fragments at the left edge (partial words such as "atos in", "factos", "in nu", "1280") are cut-off text of the facing page and were not transcribed. Faint ruled marks and stains omitted. The word "Sic" and the figures "1 5" beneath the last paragraph are marginal/printed side remarks; "1 5" is a signature-like mark left unrendered.
